bull_case_summary: Solarvest delivered year-on-year revenue and profit growth with higher net margin, alongside a substantial backlog and growing electricity sales. Round two emphasises actual profitable execution rather than backlog alone, while keeping purchase conviction conditional on funded conversion.
bear_case_summary: Dominant EPCC exposure and the large sequential revenue decline show delivery timing sensitivity. Round two accepts quarterly profitability but notes that unknown debt and FCF leave backlog cash conversion unverified, with a premium snapshot multiple and extended chart.
key_points_of_agreement: Backlog is neither cash nor guaranteed future earnings.
Electricity sales do not neutralise dominant EPCC exposure.
key_points_of_disagreement: Whether profitable quarterly delivery adequately counters timing and financing risk for a prospective purchase.
unresolved_uncertainties: Debt and FCF adequacy for backlog delivery.
Repeatability of margins through variable project timing.
Matched valuation and sustainable entry conditions; no new delay or cost overrun is established.
